reading: Joined by the terms: Zid's Abandoned Carts / السلات المتروكة, its Merchant API folder Abandoned Carts (ZD-S-0006) and staff permission manage.store.abandonedcarts, إدارة السلات المتروكة (ZD-S-0474), are Salla's Abandoned Carts / السلات المتروكة, its Merchant API folder of that name (SA-S-1035) and its permission إدارة السلات المتروكة (SA-S-2570). Strained: its Zid Alerts statements, 'خاصية تنبيهات زد مفعلة تلقائيًا لمساعدتك في استهداف السلات المتروكة' (ZD-S-1018) and their WhatsApp messages from Zid's number (ZD-S-1019), are cited in domain D's CM-MKT-022 (abandoned cart recovery) by D-zid, another tree, and left there by the rule One thing, one domain.

Joined by the terms: Zid's checkout page settings, 'خيارات صفحة إتمام الشراء' reached from لوحة التحكم > الاعدادات (ZD-S-0961), and its API folder API's > Checkout (ZD-S-0049), are the checkout and its settings: Shopify's route checkout-settings (SH-S-5106) and Salla's dashboard link Checkout (SA-S-1685). A reading: Zid's إتمام الشراء is its word for checkout, as its own English folder name Checkout shows. Its Get Cart operation (ZD-S-0049) is also cited in CM-CHK-002, a child of CM-CHK-001, so the fit stays in one tree. Which options the page holds isn't stated beyond Zid Assurance (ZD-S-0996, domain A); Q1's gap on its decides placement is 'observation needed'.

Joined by the terms: Zid's Custom Fields / حقول مخصصة, 'إضافة معلومات إضافية لمنتجاتك أو طلباتك' (ZD-S-0963), in the settings page خصائص الطلبات والمنتجات (ZD-S-0962) with its orders tab (ZD-I-0138), are Salla's custom fields for orders, Custom fields at /orders/custom-fields (SA-S-1780) and the plan line إضافة حقول مخصصة للطلبات (SA-S-2131). Neither platform says the buyer fills them in at checkout: that rests on the capability's name, as in Salla's cell. Strained: the concern also holds product properties. Its plan line ZD-S-0963 is cited as core in domain E's CM-CNT-002 by E-zid, and the 30-minute hold of a product in the cart (ZD-S-0965) as core in domain B's CM-INV-008 by B-zid, both other trees; its product API List Product Settings (ZD-S-0964) is cited nowhere here, since it shows products, not orders (notes).

Joined on role, a reading: Zid's official working hours, 'يمكنك التحكم بأوقات العمل و إغلاق المتجر بشكل كلي مؤقتاً' at الاعدادات > المتجر > أوقات العمل الرسمية (ZD-S-0970), set when the store works, the role of Salla's Ordering hours (SA-S-1738) and its plan line تعيين أوقات استقبال الطلبات (SA-S-1991). Zid doesn't say its working hours govern when orders are received, and no Zid statement defines them; Q1's gaps on its decides and boundary placements are 'observation needed' and 'searched, not found'. Strained: the same statement's temporary closing of the store is cited as core in domain A's CM-ACC-007 (Maintenance mode) by A-zid, another tree.

Joined by the terms: Zid's Orders / الطلبات, its Merchant API folder Orders (ZD-S-0004) and webhook topic order.create (ZD-S-0057), are Salla's Orders, its Merchant API folder Orders (SA-S-1016) and event order.created (SA-S-1582). The concern holds the orders as a whole, so it lands in the parent; its editing, statuses, drafts, tags and notes are cited in CM-ORD-002, 003, 005, 011 and 013, its children. Its plan line Bulk Export Orders (ZD-I-0263), an inventory entry, is cited in domain G's CM-MIG-001 by G-zid. Its statements on shipping companies setting a status and being told an order is ready (ZD-S-1010, ZD-S-1011) are cited in CM-ORD-003 here; batch 4 may cite ZD-S-1011 in SHP, still under domain C.

A new capability only Zid shows so far: the order's payment status, with its own webhook topic order.payment_status.update, 'Triggered when an order's payment status changes to paid or unpaid' (ZD-S-0722), and its own plan lines Payment Status / حالة الدفع (ZD-S-0723) and Bulk Payment Status Update (ZD-S-0724). Searched every domain (caps: payment status; حالة الدفع; financial status; paid; unpaid): CM-ORD-003 holds the order's stages and CM-PAY-020 its payment transactions, neither the paid or unpaid state (capability note).

Moved to domain D, by the rule One thing, one domain: Zid Voice is abandoned cart recovery, 'Recover abandoned carts with a voice agent' (ZD-S-0452), 'Available now for abandoned cart recovery · Limited pilot' (ZD-S-1069), which is domain D's CM-MKT-022 (Abandoned cart and order recovery), whose Zid cell, written by D-zid, already cites ZD-S-0452 (core) and ZD-S-1069 (shows). scope.tsv names D under also. Its other statements, the place الطلبات > زد فويس (ZD-S-1067), 100 free calls (ZD-S-1068), an AI that calls on the merchant's behalf (ZD-S-1070), choosing customers from the abandoned carts or a file (ZD-S-1071) and its reason (ZD-S-1072), are left to that cell. No statement names Zid's company as Zid Voice's maker, and Q1's gap says which company provides the voice agent wasn't found.

Joined by definition, a reading: Zid Pay's activation requirements, given to the payment gateway by business entity 'ليتم اعتماد الحساب لدى بوابة الدفع' (ZD-S-0528), and the published product required 'قبل رفع طلب التفعيل' (ZD-S-0531), are checks a store passes before it can take payments through the platform's service: Salla's store verification, required to activate the payment method (SA-S-0108), and Shopify's evaluation of the business when it first applies for Shopify Payments (SH-S-0331). Its other statements are cited in CM-PAY-002, the parent, in the same tree: the Rise plan line (ZD-S-0361) and the Zid Pay contract with شركة زد (ZD-S-0533). The activation step (ZD-S-0527) is cited in both. Its provider-side onboarding (ZD-S-0534, ZD-S-0535) is cited here as extension-point. Q1's gap on its reason is 'observation needed'.

Joined by the terms: Zid Pay's العمليات (transactions), at المدفوعات > العمليات (ZD-S-0537), with the staff permission list.zidpay.transactions (ZD-I-0501), is Salla's Transactions at /payments/transactions (SA-S-1880). Refunding a transaction from the same page (ZD-S-0538, with the permission refund.zidpay.transactions, ZD-I-0521) is acting on a transaction afterwards, like Salla's endpoint to refund, void or reverse one (SA-S-0180). Its provider API for refunds (ZD-S-0055, ZD-S-0085) is cited here too. A reading: a refund to the buyer is also CM-RET-002's (Refunds). If batch 4 cites ZD-S-0538 to ZD-S-0541 there, in the RET tree, this fit becomes strained.

Joined by definition, a reading: Zid Pay's balance moves daily to 'رصيد قيد المعالجة' for deposit into the bank account (ZD-S-0545), with settlement and deposit days set each week (ZD-S-0549). That is the payment service's balance paid out to the merchant's bank account on a schedule: Salla's payments go to the e-payments balance, and the eligible dues are transferred to the bank account (SA-S-0076); Shopify's merchant chooses daily, weekly or monthly payouts (SH-S-0342). Its deposit fee (ZD-S-0548) is cited here, not in CM-PAY-007, which holds the processing fees on transactions.

Joined by definition, a reading: Zid's bank account 'لاستقبال إيداعات المبالغ المحصلة' (ZD-S-0558), to which Zid Pay settles deposits (ZD-S-0562), is the payout's bank account: Salla's bank account tied to store verification, which Salla transfers dues to (SA-S-0094), and Shopify's payout bank account requirements (SH-S-0367). Not CM-PAY-030: Q1's split says the same accounts serve the bank-transfer display, but none of this concern's statements says so. The bank-transfer statements are ZD-C-016's (ZD-S-0643). Salla's إدارة الحسابات البنكية in CM-PAY-030 shares the words الحسابات البنكية. On Zid's statements, the words name the deposit account (notes).

Joined by the terms: Zid Pay's networks, enabled per store 'من خلال إدارة زد باي' (ZD-S-0563) and returned by Zid's endpoint as the card networks and methods 'available through ZidPay' (ZD-S-0569), are mada, Visa and Mastercard ('Zid Payments gateway to accept Mada, Visa, and Mastercard', in its platform_terms). Salla's plan lines for its own service name the same networks: الدفع عبر مدى (SA-S-1959) and الدفع عبر البطاقة الائتمانية (فيزا وماستر كارد) (SA-S-1960). Its Apple Pay statements are cited in CM-PAY-012 and KNET in CM-PAY-017, both in the same tree. Its supportedNetworks field (ZD-S-0570), the provider-side form of the Open APIs, is cited in CM-PAY-004. Strained: batch 1 cites ZD-S-0362 (Apple Pay 'for faster checkout') in CM-CHK-008 and ZD-S-0571 (the buyer completes the purchase in the store) in CM-CHK-001, in the CHK tree.

Joined by the terms: رسوم زد باي / Transaction Fees, the fee on Zid Pay's transactions, set by the store's Zid plan (ZD-S-0573, ZD-S-0575), is Salla's رسوم المدفوعات الإلكترونية (SA-S-5142) and Shopify's Shopify Payments Fees (SH-S-7104).

Landed in the parent, because it is coarser than the capabilities: its charge back (ZD-S-0584) is Shopify's Chargebacks (Disputes, SH-S-7107), in CM-PAY-009, and its مبلغ احتياطي and احتجاز الأموال (ZD-S-0582, ZD-S-0583) are Shopify's reserves, a temporary hold on transactions (SH-S-0348), in CM-PAY-006. Both are children of CM-PAY-002. A reading: احتياطي is read as reserve. Strained: its Fraud Shield (ZD-S-0580) and its Growth plan line 'Fraud protection to prevent losses' (ZD-S-0374) are cited by batch 1 in CM-ORD-006 (order risk and fraud analysis), in the ORD tree. They aren't CM-PAY-010: no statement says Zid or Zid Pay covers chargebacks, and ZD-S-0585 makes them the merchant's liability.

Joined by the terms: Zid's روابط الدفع (ZD-S-0586) is the plural of Salla's رابط الدفع (SA-S-1968, إرسال رابط الدفع للعميل). Zid creates a link from a manual order, 'الطلبات > الطلبات اليدوية > إنشاء طلب جديد' (ZD-S-0587), and Salla sends its link from the order's actions (SA-S-5143). A reading: whether Zid sends the link to the buyer isn't stated. Q1's gap on its responsible placement is 'stated only in general terms'.

Joined by definition, a reading: Zid Pay enables the merchant's sales 'من خلال مقدمي خدمات الدفع' (ZD-S-0589), and Zid isn't liable where 'شركات مقدمي خدمات الدفع' don't provide the service effectively (ZD-S-0592). Those are the providers that process the platform's payment service's transactions: Shopify's processing and settlement 'carried out by Payment Processors and Financial Services Providers' (SH-S-0082), with the Payment Processor accepting, processing and settling transactions (SH-S-0086). ZD-S-0589 is also cited in CM-PAY-002, the parent, as Zid Pay's maker statement. Q1's gap: the providers' names and licences aren't held (searched, not found).

Joined by definition, a reading: in Zid Payments' Open APIs, 'an execute payment API request will be sent to the payment provider' (ZD-S-0603), for 'partners / payment service providers (PSPs) who want to integrate with Zid Payments' (ZD-S-0597). Those are the processors behind the platform's own service: Shopify Payments routes each payment to the processor most likely to authorize it (SH-S-0389), and the Payment Processor processes and settles it (SH-S-0086). Zid Payments is the English name of Zid's own gateway in its Rise plan line (ZD-S-0361). Strained, because two things don't fit. The Open APIs are a provider interface, which CM-PAY-004's anchor cells don't show (cited here as extension-point). And its merchant_linked flow, in which the merchant is onboarded at the provider and the provider shares the merchant's keys with Zid Payments (ZD-S-0534, ZD-S-0535, ZD-C-001, cited in CM-PAY-003), is how a merchant connects its own third-party gateway in CM-PAY-011. The reviewer may split out a provider interface.

Joined by the terms: Zid's بوابات الدفع الأُخرى, at المدفوعات > بوابات الدفع الأُخرى (ZD-S-0604), is Salla's بوابات الدفع الأخرى on its payment methods page (SA-S-0069). Tap is a gateway on both: Zid's for six Gulf countries (ZD-S-0607), and Salla's, which can't be connected while Salla Payments is active (SA-S-0100), as Zid's other gateway is disabled when Zid Pay is activated (ZD-S-0608).

Joined by the terms: Zid's طرق الدفع / Payment methods, with its Store Settings operation List Payment Methods (ZD-S-0615) and its plan lines طرق الدفع المتنوعة / Various Payment Methods (ZD-S-0616) and Advanced Payment Methods (ZD-S-0617), is Salla's Payment methods / طرق الدفع: its admin link (SA-S-1875) and staff permission payment_method_browse (SA-S-2433). ZD-S-0617 is also cited in CM-PAY-015 and CM-PAY-029, and ZD-S-0620 in CM-PAY-021, all in the same tree.

Joined by the terms: Zid's خدمات التقسيط and الدفع لاحقاً, 'خيارات الدفع بالتقسيط' at لوحة التحكم > المدفوعات > الدفع لاحقاً (ZD-S-0621), with Tabby (تابي) splitting the payment into 4 monthly instalments (ZD-S-0625), are Salla's وسائل الدفع الآجلة, to pay later in instalments (SA-S-0070), and its plan line الدفع بالتقسيط عبر تابي وتمارا (SA-S-1965). Tabby and Tamara are providers on both. Every statement of the concern is cited in CM-PAY-015 only.

Joined by the terms: Zid's الدفع عند الاستلام / Cash on Delivery, enabled or cancelled per shipping company from لوحة التحكم > اللوجستيات (ZD-S-0629, ZD-S-0630), with its plan line Cash on Delivery / الدفع عند الاستلام (ZD-S-0632), is Salla's الدفع عند الاستلام / Cash on delivery, its setting at shipping/shipping.cod (SA-S-1765) and plan line (SA-S-1958). Its payment_method value (ZD-S-0634) is also cited, as shows, in CM-PAY-016 and CM-PAY-030, in the same tree.

Joined by the terms: Zid's تحصيل الدفع عند الاستلام / Cash on Delivery Collection (ZD-S-0637), where under direct shipping Zid collects the amount from the customer on delivery and transfers it (ZD-S-0641, ZD-S-0636), is the cash on delivery that reaches the merchant through the platform, as Salla transfers the balance from its labels' carriers (SA-S-0122) and shows the wallet's cash-on-delivery summary (SA-S-0106). CM-PAY-029 holds both arrangements, the platform's and the merchant's own carrier, as ZD-C-014's. Its statements are cited only in CM-PAY-029 so far; batch 4 may cite them in SHP (Zid Ship), which would make this fit strained.

Joined by the terms: Zid's خدمة التحويل البنكي / Bank Transfer Payment, the store's bank account details shown on the payment page so customers pay by transfer (ZD-S-0643), with its plan line الدفع بالتحويل البنكي (ZD-S-0645), is Salla's التحويل البنكي, the bank account shown to customers at checkout (SA-S-0095), and its plan line (SA-S-1956).

Moved to domain A, by the rule One thing, one domain: الاستقطاع للمحفظة, reached from إدارة المحفظة (ZD-S-0660), withdraws a fixed amount or a percentage of the payments from the merchant's balance in Zid Pay into the wallet (ZD-S-0662, ZD-S-0663, ZD-S-0664), so that the wallet always holds a balance for expenses such as buying shipping labels (ZD-S-0665). That is a way of topping up Zid's merchant wallet, which is domain A's CM-PLN-006 (Prepaid store balance with the platform: topped up, spent on the platform's services and withdrawn), whose Zid cell A-zid wrote from ZD-C-017. Its statements are left to that cell; none is cited here. CM-PAY-005 (payouts) isn't it: the amount doesn't go to the bank account, and Salla's statement that money can't move from the e-payments balance to the store balance (SA-S-0091) is cited in CM-PLN-006. scope.tsv gives the concern C with no also, so the coordinator moves it.

Joined by definition, a reading: تمويل زد / Zid Financing, a service Zid provides that lets the merchant use a financing party's offers and lets the financing party receive repayments from the merchant's Zid Pay sales (ZD-S-0692), deducted by Zid Pay (ZD-S-0699), is financing repaid from a share of the store's sales: Salla's capital, 25% of net sales collected from each payment (SA-S-0111), behind its flag financial-support (SA-S-3487). Every statement of the concern is cited in CM-PAY-026 only.

Joined on role, a reading: Zid's المستحقات المالية لمزيد, the amounts Zid's company collects for the merchant's Mazeed orders and transfers to the merchant's bank account on the 30th of each month, once the purchases are 7 days old and the amount is at least 500 riyals (ZD-S-0704), with collections weekly or monthly (ZD-S-0706, ZD-S-0707), do the job of a payout: the merchant's collected sales paid to its bank account on a schedule, as Salla's e-payments balance (SA-S-0076) and Shopify's payout schedule (SH-S-0342). What doesn't fit: CM-PAY-005 is the payment service's balance, and Mazeed's money comes through Mazeed's own payment gateway, in the app only (ZD-S-0703), not Zid Pay. Its holds (ZD-S-0708, ZD-S-0709) are cited in CM-PAY-006, in the same tree. It is strained because E-zid cites its where statements (ZD-S-0702 core, ZD-S-0703 shows) in E's CM-CHN-002 (the platform's own marketplace). For the reviewer: split out the marketplace's collections, or move them to CM-CHN-002. Its reason (ZD-S-0712, refund costs shared with Mazeed) isn't cited (notes).

Joined by the terms: Zid Pay's الأنشطة المحظورة / Prohibited Activities, the activities and entities in which Zid Pay may not be used (ZD-S-0765), 'الأنشطة المحظورة أو المقيدة' updated at any time (ZD-S-0770), are Shopify's Prohibited and Restricted Businesses for Shopify Payments, business models Shopify Payments can't support (SH-S-0327), with the prohibited and restricted categories of each Payment Processor (SH-S-0109). The anchor lands SH-C-173 in CM-PAY-002, the platform's own payment service. It is strained: A-zid cites nine of its statements in A's CM-TRU-009 (Acceptable use and enforcement), four of them as core, and its holds (ZD-S-0772, ZD-S-0769) are cited in CM-PAY-006, another tree of PAY. By One thing, one domain, the payment service's own prohibited list is where the anchor put Shopify's, so I land it here; the coordinator decides which domain holds the statements (notes).

Joined by the terms: Zid's اعدادات الضرائب, where ضريبة القيمة المضافة is activated (ZD-S-0814), and its plan line إعدادات الفواتير والضرائب / Invoice & Tax Settings (ZD-S-0815), are Salla's Tax settings / إعدادات الضريبة at /payments/taxes (SA-S-1879) and its plan line ضريبة القيمة المضافة (SA-S-2138). Its tax number and VAT certificate (ZD-S-0817, ZD-S-0820) are also cited in CM-TAX-003, a child of CM-TAX-001.

Joined by the terms: Zid's اعدادات الفاتورة / Invoice settings at لوحة التحكم > الاعدادات (ZD-S-0821), with its plan line طباعة الفواتير / Invoice Printing (ZD-S-0822), are Salla's Invoice settings at /orders/invoice-settings (SA-S-1778) and its plan line طباعة فاتورة الطلب (SA-S-1987). Batch 1 wrote CM-ORD-008's Zid cell from this concern's five statements. Its plan line Invoice & Tax Settings (ZD-I-0200) is shared with ZD-C-051, and its ERP statement (ZD-S-0825) is named, not cited, in CM-PAY-028's reading.

Joined by the terms: Zid's الربط مع منصة فاتورة (ZATCA), in the dashboard's settings (ZD-S-0826), linking the store directly with هيئة الزكاة والضريبة والجمارك for the second phase of e-invoicing (ZD-S-0829), is Salla's الربط بهيئة الزكاة والضريبة والجمارك (SA-S-2120), which links the store's tax invoices and uploads them to ZATCA through Salla (SA-S-0148).

Joined by definition, a reading: Zid's credit and debit notes, 'إشعارات فواتير' issued and sent whenever an order is cancelled or edited (ZD-S-1007), the original invoice left unchanged under ZATCA's rules (ZD-S-1009), with the operation List Order Credit Notes in the Merchant API's Orders folder (ZD-S-0832, ZD-S-0833), are documents the platform issues on an order's invoice: Salla's Merchant API folder Order Invoice (SA-S-1021) and its event invoice.created (SA-S-1640). What doesn't fit: a note against an invoice isn't the invoice, and no other platform's cell shows credit notes; Zid gives them an API operation inside Orders, not a place of their own, so I add no capability. Its statements are also cited as shows in CM-ORD-002 and CM-ORD-004 (batch 1), in the same tree. For the reviewer: split out credit and debit notes if another platform shows them.
